title: The test environment deploys resources, then configuration, then proves a move
subtitle: P121 · disposable. The gateway and Entra groups live in the test tenant; Claude runs in a Foundry account in another tenant. The sync job runs on a test cron.

groups.title: Operator · stages run in order; each reads earlier outputs
Test tenant · resource group tagged by the run

nodes.title: 1 · Identity
lines: [[script]] tags the resource group [[tag]].
Four groups and the resolver app, named with the prefix.
State is kept on its tags.

nodes.title: 2 · Resources
lines: [[resources]]: gateway, Cosmos, network, registry.
[[secret]] arrives in the ARM request body only.
Or a 7-day [[add-password]] secret.

nodes.title: 3 · Configure and grant
lines: The resolver needs the [[app-id]] from Graph.
[[configuration]]: resolver, values, job on [[cron]].
Graph grant: an Entra administrator.

nodes.title: Gateway
lines: Validates the developer token and reads access from the projection.
Calls the resolver with its identity.

nodes.title: Resolver and Cosmos
lines: Public resolver, Easy Auth, gateway is the only caller.
Private Cosmos and resolver storage endpoints.

nodes.title: Sync job
lines: Reads the tier and unit groups through Graph on each run; writes Cosmos; prints membership lines.
Console lines reach the gateway's workspace through a diagnostic setting.

nodes.title: Foundry account
lines: The gateway gets a token with [[client-credentials]] for an app in this tenant.
No managed identity crosses the tenant boundary.

nodes.title: Smoke
lines: Standard model 200, premium 403. The user moves group and unit in Entra.
After the next scheduled run: premium 200; membership lines place the user in unit b.

nodes.title: Teardown
lines: Deletes only objects whose names pass the [[names]].
Keeps the resource group while anything is left.

notice: Without the Graph grant the scheduled runs stop at the Graph stage; the smoke steps that need a scheduled run wait for an administrator. The test cron is not one of the production intervals (ADR-0058).
